command:
set -eu
SSH='ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null'
SCP='scp -q -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null'
for n in node2 node3 node4; do
  $SCP /root/minio-bootstrap/minio.env /root/minio-bootstrap/public.crt /root/minio-bootstrap/private.key /root/minio-bootstrap/root.crt root@"$n":/tmp/
  $SSH root@"$n" 'install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /tmp/minio.env /etc/default/minio; install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /tmp/public.crt /etc/minio/certs/public.crt; install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /tmp/private.key /etc/minio/certs/private.key; install -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/root.crt /etc/minio/certs/CAs/root.crt; rm -f /tmp/minio.env /tmp/public.crt /tmp/private.key /tmp/root.crt'
done
sudo install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /root/minio-bootstrap/minio.env /etc/default/minio
sudo install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /root/minio-bootstrap/public.crt /etc/minio/certs/public.crt
sudo install -m 640 -o root -g minio-user /root/minio-bootstrap/private.key /etc/minio/certs/private.key
sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root /root/minio-bootstrap/root.crt /etc/minio/certs/CAs/root.crt
for n in node1 node2 node3 node4; do $SSH root@"$n" 'sha256sum /etc/default/minio /etc/minio/certs/public.crt /etc/minio/certs/private.key' | sed "s/^/$n /"; done
